subject.title: feat(ui): permanent OpenClaw presence — pinned sidebar entry and Settings dock

question: Should the custodian route be default-pinned for fresh and default-fallback sidebar profiles, while profiles with saved pin sets remain unchanged?
rationale: The code deliberately changes a navigation default without migrating saved preferences; whether the default-fallback audience is the intended rollout population is a product and upgrade-policy choice.

options.title: Approve fresh/default-fallback pinning
options.body: Accept the current design after final-head proof confirms normal and onboarding route behavior, keeping persisted pin selections untouched.

options.title: Restrict the rollout further
options.body: Add an explicit first-run/versioned onboarding condition if existing default-fallback profiles must not gain the custodian pin automatically.

recommendation.title: Approve fresh/default-fallback pinning
recommendation.body: Accept the current design after final-head proof confirms normal and onboarding route behavior, keeping persisted pin selections untouched.
